title: Custom API / Backend Service Database Access
summary: 研究 Supabase Edge Function 作為 trusted backend service 時的資料庫存取與 transaction boundary。Phase A Access Model 與 Phase B Operation Model 已完成 runtime verification：PostgreSQL object privilege、RLS 與 RPC Function EXECUTE 可形成可分離的 authorization boundaries；Backend Service 可在沒有 direct table UPDATE privilege 時透過 approved SECURITY DEFINER operation 完成指定修改。Phase C Transaction Model 尚待驗證。
flow: Phase A VERIFIED: backend service identity → PostgreSQL object privilege / RLS → Native Data API CRUD. Phase B VERIFIED: SECURITY INVOKER / DEFINER + Function EXECUTE establish an operation-level authorization boundary; approved RPC can write while direct table UPDATE remains denied. Phase C PLANNED: compare separate Data API DELETE + INSERT with one atomic RPC operation under forced INSERT failure. Phase D optional/deferred.
